E0618

Scope members can't be nested.

What

Scope members can't be nested.

Why

Each member is a top-level region of the marker block; nesting one inside another member or a control block has no meaning.

Fix

Move the member out to the top level of the block.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0618: tests/ui/scope_member_nested.stderr.

Error [E0618]: scope members can't be nested
  --> tests/ui/scope_member_nested.jet:7:9
    |
  7 |         .skip {
    |         ^
 Why: each `.skip`-style member is a top-level region of the block; nesting one inside another member or a control block has no meaning
 Fix: move `.skip { … }` out to the top level of the block
